items.title: The Last of the Druids Weekend Sale - Get One Free Mystery Box When You Spend Points
items.summary: This weekend, we’re running a sale on microtransactions from past Mystery Boxes, including the Last of the Druids cosmetic effects. In addition, we’re offering one free Curse of the Allflame Mystery Box when you spend points in the store. Find out more in this news post.
